_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. bind_address 127.0.0.1 = solo (server on the same PC as the game); 0.0.0.0 = host for the whole LAN so several PCs share one leaderboard.
_games_comment: Per-game GameSpy identifiers keyed by lowercase wire gamename. Override or add titles here. secret_key is informational for the current Auth/GPCM/Sake path (accepted as-is); it matters only for a future ServerBrowser/enctypex path.
